name: Mossy Tumor
summary: Around Wellspring Lake, mossy tumors mark Teldrassil's spreading corruption. Carved from the bark and flesh of corrupted timberlings, these poisonous growths show the malevolence taking hold in the young World Tree.

sections.title: A Symptom of Teldrassil's Malaise
sections.body: Teldrassil's timberlings were made to nurture and tend the great tree's boughs, but many have grown hostile and diseased. Mossy tumors are signs of that sickness made flesh. Thick with toxins, they spread across the Mire Beasts, Tramplers, and Elder Timberlings around Wellspring Lake. Rellian Greenspyre and the keepers in Darnassus send travelers to cut away the tumors and burn them thoroughly, so their poison cannot take deeper root in the island's soil.

faq.answer: A Mossy Tumor is a diseased growth taken from a tainted timberling. Its foul poison shows that Teldrassil's nature spirits suffer from an unnatural corruption.

faq.q: Where do you find Mossy Tumors?
faq.answer: You find Mossy Tumors on corrupted timberlings around Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil, including Timberling Tramplers, Mire Beasts, and Elder Timberlings.

faq.q: Why does Rellian Greenspyre want these tumors?
faq.answer: Rellian Greenspyre wants the tumors to contain the corruption afflicting Teldrassil. He has them gathered and burned to ash so their concentrated poison cannot leach back into the soil and water.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings becoming diseased?
faq.answer: A malevolence is taking hold across Teldrassil, warping its caretakers and wild creatures. The night elves are investigating the sickness's true source, while timberlings with visible tumors are considered beyond saving.

angles.text: As a druid devoted to nature's balance, you may find toxic tumors on plant guardians like timberlings a distressing sign that something is profoundly wrong with Teldrassil.
As a night elf, you know your people planted Teldrassil to restore their lost connection to nature. Diseased growths appearing so quickly on your new home are a troubling omen.
